programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: The Ipswich Way
programs.description: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: The Tigers Return
programs.description: Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief. We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Coventry Rising
programs.description: We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Málaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Petr Cech
programs.description: One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Čech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot-stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.
